fieldValues.title: A member's stance comes from an archetype
fieldValues.decision_question: How is a group member's stance modelled?
fieldValues.context: D8 of clerk#57 (plans/wg-srs-operations.md, section 8), asked of the owner since 2026-10-12. Recorded as a proposed decision on 2026-10-16 so a session can take it: until now it existed only as PR text, which no session agenda reads.
fieldValues.decision_statement: We model a member's stance as its seat-holder `derived-from` a stance agent that `instantiates` an archetype, because those types and relations already exist.
fieldValues.rationale: Those types and relations already exist.
